children: dropped 0.57% intraday after agreeing to buy Wonder's Grubhub Campus Dining business for $300 million and separately investing $125 million in Wonder's Series D round.

Campus Dining, formerly Tapingo, lets students order from campus facilities and on-campus restaurants through an app or kiosks, pay with campus dining dollars and schedule pickup. It operates at more than 450 colleges and universities. The deal is expected to close by the first half of 2027, subject to regulatory review.

DoorDash said it intends to take Tapingo's vertically integrated technology stack beyond colleges into stadiums, hotels and similar venues. "Adding Grubhub Campus Dining to our platform will enable us to bring greater choice and convenience to college students while streamlining operations and reducing friction for universities," said Tony Xu.

The $125 million adds to a $650 million Series D announced in July, funding robotics, AI and physical expansion. Wonder runs 157 locations across the Northeast and Mid-Atlantic, a footprint it says has more than quadrupled since the start of 2025, and opens its first Texas sites in January.

title: DoorDash Stock Falls as It Buys Grubhub Campus Dining
